questions.question: True or False: In September 2026, Aston Villa's 2–1 victory over Wolverhampton Wanderers marked Unai Emery's 100th Premier League match in charge of the club.
questions.anchorClues: Unai Emery reached his century of Premier League fixtures as Aston Villa manager in September 2026, celebrating with a 2–1 West Midlands derby win at Villa Park.

questions.question: Which Premier League midfielder provided three assists in a single half during Chelsea's 4–1 win over West Ham United in September 2026?
questions.anchorClues: Enzo Fernández delivered three goal assists before the interval at the London Stadium in September 2026.

questions.question: Which player holds the Premier League record for committing the most total fouls in a single 38-match season, racking up 115 fouls?
questions.anchorClues: Bolton Wanderers forward Kevin Davies committed 115 fouls during the 2008–09 season, setting the highest single-season tally recorded by Opta.

questions.question: Who was the first player to score a Premier League hat-trick composed entirely of headers?
questions.anchorClues: Duncan Ferguson scored three headed goals for Everton in a 3–2 win against Bolton Wanderers on 28 December 1997.

questions.question: Which club holds the Premier League record for the most total yellow cards received in a single season, accumulating 105 cautions?
questions.anchorClues: Chelsea set the single-season yellow card record during the 2023–24 campaign under Mauricio Pochettino, amassing 105 total cautions.

questions.question: Who scored the very first Premier League goal for Manchester City at the Etihad Stadium in August 2003?
questions.anchorClues: Trevor Sinclair netted after 14 minutes against Portsmouth on 23 August 2003 to open Manchester City's league account at their new home ground.

questions.question: Which manager endured a 19-match winless start to a Premier League campaign with Sheffield United between November 2020 and January 2021?
questions.anchorClues: Chris Wilder suffered a 19-match winless run with Sheffield United during the 2020–21 season before finally securing a 1–0 win against Newcastle United.

questions.question: Which goalkeeper scored a Premier League goal from a distance of 91.9 metres after just 13 seconds of play in November 2013?
questions.anchorClues: Stoke City goalkeeper Asmir Begović beat Southampton's Artur Boruc after just 13 seconds at the Britannia Stadium on 2 November 2013.

questions.question: Which player was the first in Premier League history to convert penalties with both his right foot and his left foot in the same match?
questions.anchorClues: Bobby Zamora converted a right-footed penalty and a left-footed penalty for Fulham against Sunderland on 30 April 2011.

questions.question: Which outfield player played the highest total number of Premier League matches (310 games) without ever scoring a goal or providing a goal assist?
questions.anchorClues: Republic of Ireland defender Kenny Cunningham made 310 Premier League appearances across 12 seasons for Wimbledon and Birmingham City without scoring or registering an assist.
